# Versioning workflow

A workspace per thread, landing finished work, the revision graph, changed-file review and undo per turn. Works with jj and git.

Pack id `versioning`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/jj-integration`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/jj-integration/README.md) — One jj workspace per thread, with a manual integration dashboard and optional Project Checks-verified automatic integration.
2. [`@dshfiles/jujutsu`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/jujutsu/README.md) — Jujutsu revision graph and confirmed Source Control actions for DSH.
3. [`@dshfiles/diff-viewed`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/diff-viewed/README.md) — Mark changed files as viewed in the DSH change review tab, with per-turn progress.
4. [`@dshfiles/session-undo`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/session-undo/README.md) — Undo and redo a thread's last turn: the conversation forks back before it and the workspace files return to their snapshot, through the VCS provider (jj operations in a jj workspace).

## Prerequisites

1. A project is added.
2. The project is a jj or git repository.

## Key settings

1. **Isolate each new thread in its own workspace**: Settings entry `jj-integration`, field `isolateByDefault`.
2. **Keep a revision per turn for undo**: Settings entry `dshfiles-session-undo`, field `turnRevisions`.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Versioning workflow under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `versioning`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs versioning` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
